metadata.purpose: Each retail metro location pairs with a frontier sister location. Every pair carries a retailer list and a monthly local ingredient sourced from a local farmers market. Drives seasonal recipe-card localization and retailer logo lockups.
metadata.monthly_ingredient_mechanism: monthly_ingredients maps ISO month (YYYY-MM) -> in-season local ingredient for the frontier sister's farmers market. Populate the current month at seed time; the other 11 months are filled by a research dispatch (ghost research task) that resolves each frontier market's seasonal produce calendar from the linked farmers_market_url + regional extension-service crop calendars. Entries marked research_todo=true are placeholders awaiting that dispatch.

metro_location.name: Publix Super Market at The Plaza Midtown
metro_location.address: 950 W Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309

frontier_sister.note: Sandersville downtown farmers market — central Georgia (Washington County), kaolin-belt farm community; frontier gap sister to metro Atlanta Publix

monthly_ingredient_notes.2026-09: Muscadine grapes peak Aug-Sep across central Georgia; Washington County / Sandersville-area farm stands carry them in September. Real in-season pick. Pancake tie: muscadine compote over KODIAK Power Cakes. Candidate follow-ons for the research dispatch: pecans (Oct-Nov), figs (late summer), sweet potatoes (Oct-Dec), collards (winter).

metro_location.name: Costco Wholesale (San Francisco / Redwood City halo for the Pescadero frontier gap)
metro_location.note: phone left null pending confirmation; do not fabricate. SF/bay-area pair is confirmed present in repo as data/localization/bay-area/pescadero-94060.json (frontier=true, fulfillment=direct). frontier_sister.note: Pescadero is itself the frontier gap (nearest no-retailer spot to SF/Oakland). Local sourcing runs through Pescadero farm stands: Harley Farms Goat Dairy, Fifth Crow Farm, plus Half Moon Bay Farmers Market (Saturdays). farmers_market_url points at Harley Farms as the anchor cross-promo; Half Moon Bay Farmers Market has no stable standalone URL confirmed — research dispatch to verify.

monthly_ingredient_notes.source: Derived from confirmed seasonal_matrix in data/localization/bay-area/pescadero-94060.json: strawberries May-Sep (Fifth Crow), artichokes Mar-Jun centerfold April (Castroville), Brussels sprouts Sep-Feb peak Oct-Dec (Fifth Crow), olive oil Nov press. This is mapped from existing confirmed repo data, not fabricated.
monthly_ingredient_notes.2026-09: strawberries May-Sep, still in window in September; September also opens the Brussels sprouts season (Sep-Feb). Strawberries chosen as the cleaner single September pick.
